I have resolved the `NetworkOnMainThreadException` by moving the network request off the main thread.

### Root Cause
In [MainActivity.kt](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c3-agy-B-r2/work/app/src/main/kotlin/vn/shelftap/lab/MainActivity.kt#L25-L36), `CatalogClient().fetchCatalog()` was invoked synchronously inside `load.setOnClickListener`. Because `View.OnClickListener` callbacks run on the main UI thread, executing blocking network calls via OkHttp triggered Android's StrictMode `NetworkOnMainThreadException`.

### Solution
Updated [MainActivity.kt](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c3-agy-B-r2/work/app/src/main/kotlin/vn/shelftap/lab/MainActivity.kt#L25-L36) to run the network call asynchronously using Kotlin Coroutines:
- Used `lifecycleScope.launch` to launch a coroutine tied to the activity's lifecycle.
- Wrapped the blocking `CatalogClient().fetchCatalog()` call with `withContext(Dispatchers.IO)` so the network request executes on an IO thread pool.
- Updated `output.text` on the main thread upon completion.
